description: Airfield-capability layer VALIDATION FIXTURE - Airbus Consulting runway capability study for Southampton (RP2541272, draft 15 Dec 2025, Egnyte /Shared/Archive/2025/SOU - Aircraft Performance Analysis - 2025). The layer must reproduce these achievable-passenger figures before the approach is locked (John, 4 Jul 2026). Mechanism to replicate: the runway limits available take-off weight (not MTOW); payload then falls with distance via the fuel load. Acceptance: seats within ~5% per row, and the structure right (runway 20 > runway 02 by up to 4%; summer 3-5% below winter; payload falls with ESAD).

aircraft.notes: no ACT, no cargo containers, 100% LF no freight, JAR 5% contingency

airport.landing: MLW reached on wet RWY02; 950 kg landing weight penalty on RWY20 (non-grooved)

headline_findings: runway length prevents MTOW but achievable payloads highly satisfactory
RWY20 departures up to 4% more payload than RWY02, both seasons
summer (28C) payload up to 5% below winter (17C)
DLM/HER/LPA always >90% LF; AYT/PFO/TFS 87-96%; SSH (furthest, 2,156-2,187nm ESAD) 73-80%
return legs always equal or better payload than outbound from SOU
